'''Outpost Zerek''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Military/Legends|Military]] installation on the edge of the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Old Republic" />
